The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1967–68 season''' was contested by 18 teams. [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]] won the championship. This season, no teams relegated, due to bankruptcy of [[XerxesDZB|Xerxes/DHC]] and a merger between [[Fortuna Sittard|Fortuna '54]] and [[Fortuna Sittard|Sittardia]] into [[Fortuna Sittard|Fortuna Sittardia Combinatie]] (or Fortuna SC).

==Teams==

A total of 18 teams are taking part in the league.
